.claude/reference/ui/components/right-sidebar/tasks/index.md
19:#### Description
20-
21-The tab is one scrolling column, with a [ScrollbarScope](../../scrollbar/index.md#scrollbar-scope), read top to bottom as a timeline, in three groups, each headed by a small muted label with its count: "Previous", every task that has run, oldest at the top, as the [PromptEditor](../../../../scope/prompt-mode/index.md#prompt-editor)'s previous tasks are, with their filters and batch actions along the group's heading; "Running", every task under way, in either lane; and "Queued", the queue, in its order, as the [QueueListScope](../../../../scope/prompt-mode/queue-list/index.md#queue-list-scope) says, reordered by dragging, its auto-send switch and "Send next" button along its heading. A group with nothing in it shows its heading alone, muted, "No queued prompts" and the like. Each time the tab is shown, it is scrolled so the Running group, or the start of the Queued one when nothing runs, is in view.
22-The Previous group starts collapsed: its heading alone shows, with its count and a right chevron, and none of its rows. Clicking the heading, anywhere but its filter and batch actions, expands it, the chevron turning down, its rows showing above Running, the newest nearest it, and clicking again collapses it. It is collapsed each time a project is opened, and otherwise stays as it was left while the application runs, each open project keeping its own. While it is collapsed, its filters and batch actions still work and its count still follows them, and opening a previous task from elsewhere, as from the running activity list, expands it to show that task.
23-
24-#### Rows
25-
26-Every task is one row, 28 pixels tall, as a queued prompt's is: a bar 2 pixels wide down its left edge in its mode's colour, as the [PromptModesScope](../../../../scope/prompt-mode/modes/index.md#prompt-modes-scope) colours it, then its status, a spinner while it is under way, a tick, cross, or dash once it has ended, or, queued, its place in the queue, then the first line of its prompt, cut off with an ellipsis, then, at its right, muted, how long it took, or has been running, as the [MessageList](../../../../scope/prompt-mode/message-list/index.md#message-list) writes it. A chain is one row, its steps as rows indented beneath it, collapsed to start with, as the previous tasks group a chain. Clicking a row opens it, as below, and the row stays highlighted while it is open. Hovering a row shows its prompt's first lines in its tooltip.
27-
28-#### Virtualized
29-
30-The list is virtualized: however many tasks the project has run, it lays out and draws only the rows in view, and a few rows either side of it, never every row, so opening the tab, scrolling it, resizing the sidebar, filtering, and new tasks arriving cost the same with ten thousand previous tasks as with ten. Every row is 28 pixels tall, group headings and a chain's expanded steps included, so where each row lies is known from its place in the list alone, without laying out the rows before it, and the scrollbar's thumb is sized and placed from the whole list's height, as though every row were drawn.
31-A row is drawn only from what its row shows, its mode, status, first line, and time, read from each task's history record once and kept, never by reading a record's output, lines, or snapshots while scrolling; those are read only when a task is opened. Running rows update their time and spinner in place, redrawing only what is in view. Scrolling to a row, as when the tab opens on Running, a filter changes, or a queued row is dragged past the edge, jumps straight to its place without drawing the rows between. A row scrolled out of view and back is the same as it was, its chain expanded or not, its selection and highlight kept.

content.text:
The Previous group in the Tasks tab now starts collapsed, showing only its heading with the count and a right chevron. The full test suite passes, including a new test for the collapsed default and the heading toggle; I haven't tried it in the running app.

- **Expanding and collapsing:** clicking the heading expands the group and the chevron turns down; clicking again collapses it. Clicks on the filter button and batch actions are left to those controls and don't toggle the group.
- **While collapsed:** filters and batch actions still work, and the count follows the filters.
- **When it resets:** each newly opened project starts collapsed, and a project you switch back to keeps the state you left it in.
- **Opening a task from elsewhere:** opening a finished task from outside the tab, such as the running activity list, expands the group so the task shows.

The change is in `src/prompt_mode/tasks_tab.rs`. Five existing tests expected the Previous rows to be showing, so they now expand the group first. This all follows the spec, which matches your prompt.
